rows.text: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.

"Team Trailblazer takes the lead! The finish line is within reach. Can Team Trailblazer clinch the final victory?"
On the highly anticipated track, the roar of engines and the cheers of the crowd intertwine.

"Keep up this speed and charge straight ahead! Baseball Raccoon, you can do this!"
An inner voice cheers them on, firm and resolute.

In the instant before breaking through the finish line, the heartbeat, the wind, the deafening voices, and the sound of the acceleration reach a synchronized frequency, fading into silence.
And in the racer's eyes, all that remains is a vast track leading to the sky.

Suddenly, thunderous applause and celebratory cannons erupt.
"I... won! Team Trailblazer won!"
As the afterglow of the setting sun spills across the edge of the horizon, the euphoria of victory has arrived.
